summary: rotate, turn, yaw, spin the robot or drone by an angle in degrees; face left, face right, turn around
description: Rotates the robot or drone by a requested relative yaw angle. Command format: 'rotate <degrees>' where positive degrees turn left/counterclockwise and negative degrees turn right/clockwise. Output confirms rotation start, current yaw if available, and completion. Report when rotation starts, completes, or fails.
